About

Hello! I'm David Millard, a Ph.D. student in Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at the Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), working in probabilistic machine learning, reinforcement learning, and physics-informed neural networks. I am currently a member of the Safe AI Lab (SAIL), advised by Dr. Ali Baheri.

I also attended RIT for my undergraduate, where I earned a BS Computer Science and Statistics. During my time in undergraduate I collaborated with various labs: Dr. Arielle Carr at Lehigh University, Stéphane Gaudreault at Environment and Climate Change Canada, and SAIL with Dr. Ali Baheri.

Outside of academic work, I enjoy spending time with my animals, Didly and Buck, and staying active. For collaborations or inquiries, contact me @ djm3622@rit.edu.
